paragraphs.text: Religious duties get put in their place — not thrown out, just ranked. Vows, giving, bathing, sitting through austerities: all they do is cool down the heat of becoming. But thinking about scripture as if it were nectar waters the mind with a streaming bliss-river.
So there are two tools with two different jobs, and the song is honest about both: rites are not despised, they are relativized — and then the higher means gets offered.
